header: People who trained here and went on
lead: Twenty-six apprentices have finished their training at Aubruck since 1998. These are the ones who agreed to be listed, with what they are doing now.
note: If you worked here and would like to be on this list, or would like to come off it, write to Katja Sunder. Nobody is added without being asked.

people.title: Verena Kolb
people.text: Now at the Sandau city planning office, on the same side of the table as her old clients.

people.title: Simon Baumgartner
people.text: Teaches surveying at the technical college in Sandau. Three of our apprentices have been his students.

people.title: Miriam Deutsch
people.text: Project manager at a rail contractor. Still rings Milan about levelling questions.

people.title: Nikolaus Ferk
people.text: Runs his own two-person office in Nauwang. We refer work to each other most months.

people.title: Tanja Ebersberg
people.text: Moved to the cadastral office in Sandau, which is where half the district's boundary files end up.

people.title: Josef Rauner
people.text: Retired. Comes in twice a year to read the old field books nobody else can.
